label: Round Cuff — 2 Buttons, 1 Buttonhole
description: The round two-button cuff is a barrel cuff with rounded outer corners secured by two buttons stacked along its depth. The pair of buttons makes the cuff taller and dressier than a one-button version and provides extra room to accommodate a watch, while the rounded corners soften the look. It strikes a balance between formal polish and everyday wearability.
